name: Chatmu
description:
Chatmu is the MCP connector for the music industry, built for artists, managers, A&Rs, bookers, and music industry professionals. Under the motto "AI for the industry, humans for the music," it connects Claude to real music industry data and automates much of the operational workload that typically falls on these roles, so users can focus on creative and strategic decisions. Authentication happens via OAuth 2.0, using the account users already have on chatmu.io. 
The connector brings together around 132 active tools. It covers real-time artist analytics — stats, audience demographics, fan retention, growth trajectory, and listener geography — along with discovery and A&R capabilities, letting users find emerging artists, global superstars, genre competitors, and strategic collaborators or opening acts. It also includes the complete music distribution flow, from creating a release draft to submitting it for review, with audio and cover art uploads, metadata editing, and an interactive wizard that guides the user step by step. On the networking and CRM side, it supports managing industry contacts, building pitches for playlist curators, and sending email — including mass campaigns capped at 500 recipients with a confirmation step before sending. Rounding out the toolset are charts, playlist, and radio tools for measuring editorial reach and spins, along with music video creation capabilities through templates and interactive widgets, plus a feature that detects AI-generated or AI-processed music.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Chatmu to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Chatmu to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-chatmu.aaatmi.com/mcp-oauth. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Chatmu MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Chatmu lists 131 MCP tools, including RAG_artist_context, analyze_artist_growth_trends, analyze_audience_conversion, analyze_cross_platform_performance, analyze_growth_rates_fixed, analyze_industry_tiers, analyze_instagram_media, analyze_label_history, analyze_market_locations, analyze_niche_compatibility, analyze_raw_audio_url, and analyze_social_to_streaming_conversion.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Chatmu?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Chatmu in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Chatmu requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Chatmu is developed by AAATMI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
